{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter for: LOYAL customers AND completed status AND exclude QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
filtered_df = df[
    (df['customer_segment'].str.lower() == 'loyal') &
    (df['status'] == 'completed') &
    (df['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99)
]

# Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue = filtered_df['revenue_clean'].mean()

# Print the result
mean_revenue"}
